'''Fanor Mondragón Pérez''' is a Colombian [[chemist]], [[professor]] and [[Scientist|researcher]],<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-08-17|title=La Ley de Regalías 2020|url=https://www.elespectador.com/opinion/columnistas/salomon-kalmanovitz/la-ley-de-regalias-2020-column/|access-date=2021-08-27|website=El Espectador}}</ref> recognized for his research on the impact of fossil fuels on the environment. Member of the Colombian Academy of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences, during his career he has won various awards, such as the [[Francisco Antonio Zea]] University Merit Medal and the Fulbright Research Grant, among others.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Premiados siete investigadores colombianos|url=https://legadoweb.minciencias.gov.co/noticias/premiados-7-investigadores-colombianos|access-date=27 August 2021|website=Colciencias|language=es}}</ref> He is a [[Emeritus|professor emeritus]] of the [[University of Antioquia]]<ref name=":2" /> and an ambassador for [[Hokkaido University|Hokkaidō University]] in Colombia.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=HU Prof. Kiyoharu Tadanaga visited HUA Prof. Fanor Mondragón Pérez at the University of Antioquia, Colombia, and delivered the HUA Appointment Certificate to him on November 27th, 2018. – HUAP|url=https://www.global.hokudai.ac.jp/huap/news-and-reports/4250/|access-date=2021-09-19|website=www.global.hokudai.ac.jp|language=en}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Mondragón was born in [[Bolívar, Valle del Cauca]].<ref name=":6">{{cite book |title=Ciencia, Humanismo y Acción. 85 Años Academia Colombiana de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales|publisher=Academia Colombiana de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales|location=Bogotá, D.C., Colombia|language=es|year=2021|isbn=978-958-794-489-1}}</ref> He studied in [[Medellín]] and graduated as a [[chemical engineer]] from the [[University of Antioquia]] in 1974.<ref name=":0" /> Later, he joined the Department of Chemistry at the University of Antioquia as a teacher and researcher.<ref name=":4">{{Cite book|last=Dominguez|first=Eduardo|url=https://bibliotecadigital.udea.edu.co/bitstream/10495/11521/1/DominguezEduardo_2019_%20%20CienciaVidaInvestigadoresUniversidadAntioquia.pdf|title=Entre la Ciencia y la Vida - Diálogos con investigadores de la Universidad de Antioquia|publisher=Universidad de Antioquia|year=2019|isbn=978-958-5526-25-9|language=es|access-date=19 September 2021}}</ref> He obtained a scholarship from Japan's Ministry of Education, through the Japanese embassy in Colombia, to do his postgraduate studies at [[Hokkaidō University]] in [[Sapporo]].<ref name=":4" /> In Hokkaido he completed his master's (1980–1981) and doctorate (1981–1984) degrees with professor Koji Ouchi,<ref name=":5">{{Cite web|title=Espíritus libres: egresados Universidad de Antioquia - Primera edición|url=https://babel.banrepcultural.org/digital/collection/p17054coll10/id/1273|access-date=2021-09-20|website=babel.banrepcultural.org|language=es}}</ref> working on the structure and chemical reactions of coal.<ref name=":4" /> Its doctoral committee included [[Akira Suzuki (chemist)|Akira Suzuki]], winner of the [[Nobel Prize in Chemistry]].<ref name=":3"/>

Upon finishing his studies, Mondragón returned to the University of Antioquia and in 1984 took over the leadership of the Chemical Group for Energy Resources and the Environment (QUIREMA), founded by professor Gustavo Quintero in 1982.<ref name=":5" /> He has held various positions at his [[alma mater]], such as teacher, coordinator of the doctorate in chemical sciences and vice-chancellor for research.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Fanor Mondragón Pérez|url=https://scienti.minciencias.gov.co/cvlac/visualizador/generarCurriculoCv.do?cod_rh=0000087890|access-date=27 August 2021|website=Colciencias}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-01-11|title=Profesores de la U. de Antioquia, de los más citados en el país|url=https://www.eltiempo.com/archivo/documento/CMS-15084115|access-date=2021-08-27|website=El Tiempo|language=es}}</ref> During his time as vice-chancellor, he visited the Colombian embassy in Korea to promote relations between the universities of both countries.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Visita del Vicerrector de la Universidad de Antioquia a la Embajada de Colombia en Corea|url=https://corea.embajada.gov.co/node/news/3393/visita-del-vicerrector-la-universidad-antioquia-la-embajada-colombia-corea|access-date=2021-09-20|website=corea.embajada.gov.co|archive-date=2021-09-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210920212559/https://corea.embajada.gov.co/node/news/3393/visita-del-vicerrector-la-universidad-antioquia-la-embajada-colombia-corea|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was appointed professor emeritus of the University of Antioquia in September 2019.<ref name=":2">[https://www.udea.edu.co/wps/wcm/connect/udea/b1efa6b1-3acd-452c-b99e-0e08f73009fc/RA3357.pdf?MOD=AJPERES&CVID=mYkpauy&attachment=true&id=1576595112977 Profesor Emérito Universidad de Antioquia Resolución Académica Septiembre de 2019]</ref>

Since 2021 Mondragón has been a full member of the [[Colombian Academy of Exact, Physical, and Natural Sciences|Colombian Academy of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences]],<ref name=":6"/><ref>{{Cite web|title=Miembros (In Spanish)|url=https://accefyn.org.co/miembros/|access-date=2021-12-03|website=Academia Colombiana de Ciencias Exactas Físicas y Naturales|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Crisis global por cambio climático y dióxido de carbono (In Spanish)|url=http://radio.unal.edu.co/detalle/crisis-global-por-cambio-climatico-y-dioxido-de-carbono|access-date=2021-12-03|website=radio.unal.edu.co|date=December 2021 }}</ref> where he coordinates the permanent commission on science, technology and innovative society.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Grupos|url=https://accefyn.org.co/grupos/|access-date=2021-09-23|website=Academia Colombiana de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales|language=es}}</ref> He served as president of the Ibero-American Federation of Catalysis Societies (FISOCAT) between 2016 and 2020.<ref>{{cite web|title=FISOCAT - Historia|url=http://www.fiq.unl.edu.ar/fisocat/historia.htm|access-date=2021-09-19|website=www.fiq.unl.edu.ar}}</ref> In November 2018, professor Kiyoharu Tadanaga visited the University of Antioquia to present Mondragón with the certificate of his appointment as ambassador of Hokkaidō University in Colombia.<ref name=":3" /> In 2020, he was elected to the board of directors of the non-profit association [[Ruta N]].<ref>{{cite web|date=2020-08-21|title=Esta es la nueva junta directiva de Ruta N|url=https://vivirenelpoblado.com/esta-es-la-nueva-junta-directiva-de-ruta-n/|access-date=2021-08-27|website=Vivir en El Poblado|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Arias|first=Ferney|date=2020-09-03|title=Más nombramientos en junta de Ruta N|url=https://www.elcolombiano.com/negocios/innovacion/ruta-n-ajusta-junta-directiva-FB13567417|access-date=2021-08-27|website=El Colombiano}}</ref>

His work has focused on hydrocarbons, their effect on the environment, and on sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels.<ref name=":0" /> Mondragón has received various recognitions during his academic career.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> Mondragón collaborated with Colombian senator Iván Darío Agudelo in the creation and preparation of a bill for the creation of the Ministry of Science and Technology in Colombia.<ref name=":6" />

== Selected publications ==

* Alejandro Molina, '''Fanor Mondragon'''. 1998. Reactivity of coal gasification with steam and CO<sub>2</sub>. ''Fuel''; 77(15): 1831–1839. [[doi:10.1016/S0016-2361(98)00123-9]]
* Germán Sierra Gallego, '''Fanor Mondragón''', Joel Barrault, Jean-Michel Tatibouët, Catherine Batiot-Dupeyrat. 2006. CO<sub>2</sub> reforming of CH4 over La–Ni based perovskite precursors. ''Applied Catalysis A: General''; 311:164-171. [[doi:10.1016/j.apcata.2006.06.024]]
* Carlos Enrique Daza, Jaime Gallego, '''Fanor Mondragón''', Sonia Moreno, Rafael Molina. 2010. High stability of Ce-promoted Ni/Mg–Al catalysts derived from hydrotalcites in dry reforming of methane. ''Fuel''; 89(3): 592–603. [[doi:10.1016/j.fuel.2009.10.010]]
* German Sierra Gallego, Catherine Batiot-Dupeyrat, Joel Barrault, Elizabeth Florez, '''Fanor Mondragon'''. 2008. ''Applied Catalysis A: General''; 334(1–2): 251–258. doi: 1[[doi:10.1016/j.apcata.2007.10.010|0.1016/j.apcata.2007.10.010]]
* '''Fanor Mondragon''', Fabio Rincon, Ligia Sierra, Jaime Escobar, Jose Ramirez, John Fernandez. 1990. New perspectives for coal ash utilization: synthesis of zeolitic materials. ''Fuel''; 69(2): 263–266. [[doi:10.1016/0016-2361(90)90187-U]].
